pages.text: A strong river breeze blew all morning. Ddori sat at the bow in a round hat. Mom prepared noodles beside Ddori.
A gust blew. The hat was gone! Mom quickly hugged Ddori. Waaa! Bung wanted the crying to stop. "What is wrong, Ddori? I will help."
Bung thought Ddori was hungry and offered noodles. Ddori turned away.
Bung thought Ddori was sleepy and spread a blanket. Ddori kicked it off.
Bung thought Ddori was bored and shook a rattle. Ddori cried louder.
Nothing else to offer! Bung sat down with both hands over the ears.
Ddori stretched out one finger. Bung only looked at Ddori's face.
Mom gently lifted Ddori's hand. The fingertip pointed at the water.
The round hat floated there. Grandpa fished it out with a long stick.
Bung shook off the hat and put it back on. Ddori's eyes brightened, and a little smile appeared.
